sources.milestones: /agents/visit/ (the checklist Kolaboro agents use on site)

milestones.title: Foundations
items: Rebar visible and spaced as drawn
Plot boundaries match the certificate map
No standing water or erosion at the edges

milestones.title: Structure and walls
items: Columns and beams complete on every floor
Workers and materials on site today

milestones.title: Finishes
items: Electrical and plumbing first fix done
Pool shell built (if sold with a pool)

milestones.title: Handover
items: Everything in the contract is delivered
Keys and documents handed to the buyer

items.t: The seller is the title holder
items.tip: Names on the certificate match the seller or the company selling.

items.t: The certificate is checked at the land office
items.tip: Through your notary, not a photocopy from the seller.

items.t: You know the title type and its length
items.tip: Freehold, right to build, right to use or lease, and how many years are left.

items.t: No mortgage or dispute on the land
items.tip: Ask the notary to check for registered charges and disputes.

items.t: Zoning allows what you are buying
items.tip: Villas and rentals need the right zone, not agricultural or protected land.

items.t: Building approval exists for this project
items.tip: Ask for the permit number and check it matches the plans.

items.t: Rental licence if you plan to rent
items.tip: A home that can't be legally rented can't earn the promised yield.

items.t: Permits are in the name of the selling company
items.tip: Not a different company or a person.

items.t: You've seen projects they finished
items.tip: Visit or ask a local agent to visit, not just look at renders.

items.t: You've spoken to past buyers
items.tip: Find them yourself, not only the ones the developer suggests.

items.t: The company is registered and you know the directors
items.tip: Check the company registry.

items.t: You've searched for complaints and court cases
items.tip: Search the company and directors' names with the words scam, complaint and court.

items.t: Payments are tied to construction milestones
items.tip: Not to calendar dates.

items.t: There is a penalty or refund if they deliver late
items.tip: With a clear date and amount.

items.t: You know which law and courts apply
items.tip: And whether you could realistically use them.

items.t: An independent lawyer has read it
items.tip: Paid by you, not recommended by the seller.

items.t: Every payment goes to the company named in the contract
items.tip: Never to a personal account.

items.t: The deposit is a small share of the price
items.tip: Large upfront payments carry most of the risk.

items.t: Each milestone is checked before you pay
items.tip: By someone who works for you.

items.t: You keep every receipt and transfer record
items.tip: Matching amounts, dates and account names.
